title: Nepal pitches ‘Sagarmatha to Sea’ alliance ahead of COP31

blocks.text: Nepal has proposed a new international climate partnership linking the Himalayas with vulnerable Pacific island states, seeking to build a common front among mountain and ocean countries ahead of the COP31 climate summit in Turkey next month. Foreign Minister Shisir Khanal unveiled the idea of a “Sagarmatha to the Sea” partnership while addressing a Pre-COP Leaders’ Event in Fiji on Monday. He argued that melting glaciers in the Himalayas and rising sea levels in the Pacific are different manifestations of the same climate crisis. “From Sagarmatha to the sea, we are facing the same crisis,” Khanal said.
